class.name: FmodEventDescription
class.brief_description: Metadata and factory for FMOD Studio events.
class.description: FmodEventDescription holds the static metadata for an FMOD Studio event definition. Use it to inspect event properties (3D, one-shot, parameters) and to create multiple [FmodEvent] instances. Obtain descriptions via [FmodServer]: [codeblock] var desc = FmodServer.get_event("event:/Music/Level1") var inst = FmodServer.create_event_instance_from_description(desc) inst.start() inst.release() [/codeblock]

method.name: get_guid
method.description: Returns the GUID of this event as a string.

method.name: get_instance_count
method.description: Returns the number of currently active instances created from this description.

method.name: get_instance_list
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all currently active [FmodEvent] instances created from this description.

method.name: get_length
method.description: Returns the length of the event's timeline in milliseconds. Returns [code]-1[/code] for events with no defined length.

method.name: get_min_max_distance
method.description: Returns an [Array] of two floats [code][min, max][/code] representing the 3D attenuation distance range. Only meaningful for 3D events.

method.name: get_parameter_by_id
method.description: Returns the [FmodParameterDescription] for the parameter with the given numerical ID.

method.name: get_parameter_by_index
method.description: Returns the [FmodParameterDescription] at the given index (0 to [method get_parameter_count] - 1).

method.name: get_parameter_by_name
method.description: Returns the [FmodParameterDescription] for the parameter with the given name.

method.name: get_parameter_count
method.description: Returns the number of parameters this event has.

method.name: get_parameter_label_by_id
method.description: Returns the label string at [param label_index] for the labeled (enum) parameter with the given ID.

method.name: get_parameter_label_by_index
method.description: Returns the label string at [param label_index] for the labeled (enum) parameter at the given parameter index.

method.name: get_parameter_label_by_name
method.description: Returns the label string at [param label_index] for the labeled (enum) parameter with the given name.

method.name: get_parameter_labels_by_id
method.description: Returns all label strings for the labeled (enum) parameter with the given ID. Returns an empty array for non-labeled parameters.

method.name: get_parameter_labels_by_index
method.description: Returns all label strings for the labeled (enum) parameter at the given parameter index.

method.name: get_parameter_labels_by_name
method.description: Returns all label strings for the labeled (enum) parameter with the given name.

method.name: get_parameters
method.description: Returns an [Array] of all [FmodParameterDescription] objects for this event.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the path of this event (e.g. [code]"event:/Music/Level1"[/code]).

method.name: get_sample_loading_state
method.description: Returns the loading state of this event's sample data. See [code]FMOD_STUDIO_LOADING_STATE[/code] values.

method.name: get_sound_size
method.description: Returns the sound size used for 3D occlusion calculations. Only meaningful for 3D events.

method.name: get_user_property
method.description: Returns the user property with the given name as a [Dictionary]. User properties are set on the event in FMOD Studio.

method.name: get_user_property_count
method.description: Returns the number of user properties on this event.

method.name: has_sustain_point
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event has one or more sustain points. Use [method FmodEvent.event_key_off] to advance past a sustain point.

method.name: is_3d
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event is designed for 3D spatialization.

method.name: is_one_shot
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event is a one-shot that stops and releases automatically.

method.name: is_snapshot
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event is a snapshot (applies a global mix state rather than playing audio).

method.name: is_stream
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the event streams its audio from disk rather than loading it fully into memory.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the underlying FMOD event description handle is still valid.

method.name: load_sample_data
method.description: Pre-loads this event's sample data into memory to avoid hitches on first playback. Use [method unload_sample_data] to release it.

method.name: release_all_instances
method.description: Calls [method FmodEvent.release] on all currently active instances of this event.

method.name: unload_sample_data
method.description: Releases pre-loaded sample data from memory.

method.name: user_property_by_index
method.description: Returns the user property at the given index as a [Dictionary].
